Focus.title: More attentional focusing through binaural beats: evidence from the global-local task
Focus.takeaway: Gamma-frequency binaural beats enhance attentional control and selective focus.

Focus.title: Eliminating the Attentional Blink through Binaural Beats: A Case for Tailored Cognitive Enhancement
Focus.takeaway: Binaural beat stimulation significantly reduces the attentional blink, facilitating rapid visual processing.

Focus.title: Prolonged Low-Level Exposure to the Aroma of Peppermint Essential Oil Enhances Aspects of Cognition and Mood in Healthy Adults
Focus.takeaway: Peppermint inhalation enhances memory and alertness while improving task accuracy.

Focus.title: Effects of essential oils on central nervous system: Focus on mental health
Focus.takeaway: Limonene inhalation shows strong central nervous system stimulation and mental fatigue reduction.

Calm.title: Efficacy of binaural auditory beats in cognition, anxiety, and pain perception: a meta-analysis
Calm.takeaway: Meta-analysis confirms binaural beats effectively decrease anxiety and enhance stress recovery.

Calm.title: A prospective, randomised, controlled study examining binaural beat audio and pre-operative anxiety in patients undergoing general anaesthesia for day case surgery
Calm.takeaway: Binaural beat audio reduces pre-operative state anxiety by up to 26% compared to standard audio.

Calm.title: Exploring Pharmacological Mechanisms of Lavender (Lavandula angustifolia) Essential Oil on Central Nervous System Targets
Calm.takeaway: Lavender oil interacts with NMDA receptors and SERT, exerting potent anxiolytic effects without sedation.

Calm.title: Effects of lavender on anxiety: A systematic review and meta-analysis
Calm.takeaway: Systematic review shows significant reduction in state anxiety and physiological markers (HR, cortisol) from lavender inhalation.
